editions.title: Early October football briefing
editions.summary: Five questions on men's internationals, women's club football, Asian football and the grassroots game.

questions.prompt: Which pair both scored twice for England in the 7–0 win over Croatia on 3 October 2026?
questions.hint: One is England's captain; the other usually attacks from the right.
questions.explanation: Kane and Saka each contributed two goals in England's seven-goal victory in Rijeka. The FA's post-match interview confirms both braces.

questions.prompt: Which team beat West Ham United Women 3–0 in the Women's Super League on 4 October 2026?
questions.explanation: Chelsea won 3–0 away to West Ham. The club published its match highlights and post-match reactions on 4 October 2026.

questions.prompt: Who won the first FIFA ASEAN Challenge Cup, beating Cambodia 2–0 in the final on 3 October 2026?
questions.hint: The champions hosted this tournament, including the final at Kai Tak Stadium.
questions.explanation: Hong Kong, China defeated Cambodia 2–0 to claim the inaugural Challenge Cup. This was the Challenge Cup tournament, separate from the FIFA ASEAN Cup played in Indonesia.

questions.prompt: During the extended opening window of the 2026/27 Nations League, from 24 September to 6 October, how many matches were teams generally scheduled to play?
questions.hint: The usual two-match pattern was doubled for this opening window.
questions.explanation: UEFA's dated competition guide describes a longer opening international window containing four Nations League matchdays. The question concerns the published schedule, not a prediction of results.

questions.prompt: What was the main purpose of The FA's Play Safe Weekend on 3–4 October 2026?
questions.hint: The campaign encouraged adults to listen when children talk about their football experiences.
questions.explanation: Play Safe Weekend focused on safeguarding across football. The 2026 campaign encouraged everyday conversations so children and young people feel heard and can raise concerns.
